$doc.name: carl-rpg AI reference
$doc.purpose: Machine-oriented map of every built feature of the carl-rpg FoundryVTT v13 system: data models, rules, UI entry points, settings, APIs, conventions. Written for AI agents, not humans.
$doc.source: branch carl-rpg @ d84882d. Read from module/ (data models, documents, helper headers, sheets), templates/, tests/, lang/en.json keys, and the plan doc 'Carl RPG for Foundry: Plan and Discussion Notes'. Code is truth: if this file and code disagree, trust code and fix this file.

notation.ids: values are code ids (enum keys, setting keys, flag keys). UI labels live in lang/en.json under CARL_RPG.*
notation.x = y: derived, computed at prepare time, never stored
notation.(plan): taken from the plan doc, not re-read line by line in code

status.tests: npm test -> 163 rule tests pass (node --test, stubs in tests/stubs.mjs stand in for Foundry)
status.foundryRun: NEVER run in Foundry. Every runtime behaviour below is verified only by code reading and stub tests. Playtesting is done by the user.
status.openWork: system.json url/manifest/download/bugs are placeholders. Everything else in the plan is built or dropped.

project.title: Carl RPG
project.what: Unofficial FoundryVTT system for the Dungeon Crawler Carl TTRPG (Renegade Game Studios). Built from asacolips boilerplate-system, then renamed.

layout.module/data/: TypeDataModels + shared field builders (action, costs, upgrade-field, base-item eventsField)
layout.module/documents/: Actor, Item, Combat, Combatant, ActiveEffect subclasses
layout.module/helpers/: rule logic and registerX() feature modules (about 80 files)
layout.module/canvas/token.mjs: CarlRPGToken (nameplate: crawler number, skulls, boss stars)
layout.templates/: Handlebars: actor/, item/ (+attribute-parts/), creation/, effect/, journal/, settings/, sidebar/
layout.src/scss/: SCSS source. npm run build -> css/carl-rpg.css (css/ is gitignored)
layout.src/pack.mjs: npm run pack -> build/carl-rpg (ships module css lang templates assets packs + system.json README LICENSE CHANGELOG). Never edit build/.
layout.packs-source/carl-rpg-macros.json: ready-made macros to import into a compendium (not built into a pack)

entry.init: sets CONFIG.CARL_RPG, installs fromUuid wrapper (gm-docs), preloads partials, calls every registerX(), sets document classes, data models, sheets, sidebar tab, combat config (no initiative), registers client/world settings and menus

architecture.pattern: helpers/<feature>.mjs export pure rule functions plus registerX() called once in init. Rule logic is kept free of Foundry globals where possible so tests/ can import it with stubs.

documentClasses.CarlRPGActor: module/documents/actor.mjs. applyDamage(), addGold(), spendGold(), _preCreate marks new empty crawler creationPending, mob tokens show bars, pet tokens linked+friendly, _onUpdate: 0 health -> startDying/defeatMob, >0 -> cancelDying, pet owner change grants owner permission
documentClasses.CarlRPGItem: module/documents/item.mjs (~1370 lines). roll() use flow, toggleEquipped(), syncEquipEffects(), _preCreate guards (background never on actors, pets only gear/skill/spell, race/class floor+prereq rules, subclass rules, achievement duplicates), grant skills/effects on create, release on delete, costData()/costSpans()
documentClasses.CarlRPGCombat: module/documents/combat.mjs. phase flag, nextTurn=next phase, resetActions(), refillCombatActions()
documentClasses.CarlRPGCombatant: module/documents/combatant.mjs. maxActions, actionsLeft, spendAction(), restoreAction(), buyAction()
documentClasses.CarlRPGActiveEffect: module/documents/active-effect.mjs. kind/stack/duration/equip-link/lock-by-rank, setActive() with buff swap prompt, changeStacks(), removeAllStacks()
documentClasses.CarlRPGActorDirectory: helpers/crawler-summary.mjs; adds Crawler Summary to right-click menu

sheets.actor: CarlRPGActorSheet module/sheets/actor-sheet.mjs + mixins actor-sheet-{drops,effects,personal,progression,quests-loot,upgrades}.mjs; 680x760 resizable; one sheet for crawler|mob|pet|mount; lootPile uses CarlRPGLootPileSheet
sheets.stack: ApplicationV2 + HandlebarsApplicationMixin. AppV1 sheet classes are only unregistered.

architecture.dialogs: Every dialog uses CarlRPGDialog (module/helpers/dialog.mjs: prompt, confirm, wait). Never DialogV2 directly.

gmClientDelegation.why: Players cannot edit world settings, journals, other actors, or store stock.
mechanisms: helpers/relay.mjs updateWithRelay(doc, changes): Observer's automatic changes (mana, 1 AI Favor on reroll, item uses.spent+1, combatant actionsSpent) sent as whispered ChatMessage flag updateRelay; active GM client validates (requester >= Observer, whitelisted field, bounds) then applies and deletes the message
Whisper-flag relays (GM client acts, deletes message): eventRelay, libraryRelay, lootRequest/lootResponse, mobCheckRelay, pileRelay, storeBuy, storeOpen, storeSell

Socket 'system.carl-rpg': {type:'party'} (leader renames party/sets titles; GM client verifies leader), {type:'request'|'response'} (gm-docs: player asks GM client for compendium items they cannot open)

Event trust: system.eventsTrusted (items, pets) or flags.carl-rpg.eventsTrusted (effects) set true only when a GM saves. Untrusted events cannot change actors the user does not own or run GM-side macros until a GM approves (Dungeon Info > events to approve, or Approve button on the sheet).

architecture.migration: helpers/migration.mjs: system.json version vs world setting migratedVersion. On newer version the active GM client re-saves every world actor/item (fills new fields) then runs STEPS newer than stored (STEPS=[{0.1.0: migrateClassTags}]). Saves carry option carlMigration so hooks skip side effects. Failure leaves version unrecorded (retry next load). Data models also self-heal via migrateData (old size text, hotlist->background, kills->killLog, embeddedSkill->skills, check type->target, manaCost->costs, roll->action, numeric targeting->string).

constants._note: CONFIG.CARL_RPG from module/helpers/config.mjs. Edit there, not here.

gearSlots._note: value = max equipped per slot; hands slot is labelled Held in UI; equipping into a full slot prompts which to swap

order: tiny
small
petite
medium
large
huge
colossal
gargantuan

constants.defaultDamageTypes: Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison, Acid, Necrotic, Psychic

lootTiers._note: value = default gold formula; a box may override

fields.actions: {base int init 2, perCrawler bool}; actions.max derived = base + bonuses.actions
fields.bonuses: one number per effectModifierKeys entry (init 0). Active effects ONLY write here; derived values add them. Nothing an effect does is saved into base numbers.

fields.className: string (class or subclass name, or combo race name)
fields.deity: string (Deity box; only shown when a deity item is held)
fields.gold: int>=0, only currency; add via actor.addGold(), spend via actor.spendGold()
fields.killLog: [{name, note}] Important Things I've Killed (does not change crawlerKills)

derived.abilities.<stat>: enhanced = value + bonuses.<stat>, capped by statCap build row; mod = getStatModifier(enhanced); label
derived.dr: {armor = sum of equipped gear system.dr, total = armor + bonuses.dr}
derived.health: max 10 always; perBox = mod of healthStat build row (default con); capacity = perBox*10

tabs: personal (sponsors, kills, mounts, clubs, personal space, deity)
sheet.limitedView: Limited permission sees only the Notes/biography part, locked
sheet.dragToHotbar: Rest and Level Up buttons drag to hotbar -> macro (data.carlMacro)
sheet.editMode: most fields read-only until edit mode; drop boxes show at list ends only when editable

fields.floorPinned/floorPin: GM-only pin of this mob's Floor for its own numbers (box fills once from current floor)
fields.rewardBox: UUID of loot box the GM gives chosen crawlers on defeat (Give reward button)
fields.loot: {junk string(number|dice), gold string, items [{uuid, chance 0..100}], looted bool}

derived.health.max: 1..100, one box per point; health.perBox = con mod
derived.actions: perCrawler true for elite/boss (combatant.maxActions = number of crawler combatants + bonuses.actions, counting defeated crawlers); else base + bonuses

rules: Mobs never roll a d20. A mob check number = item.system.check.number + floor; crawlers roll against it.
Mob health is damaged 1:1 by (damage - drTotal) in applyDamage (no CON division) - see quirks.
At 0 health: Crawler-kind mobs follow Dying rules, other mobs defeatMob(): skull overlay, removed from combat, flag defeatedIn=combatId (drives loot reminder).
Mob sheet tabs: abilities, mobAbilities, loot, effects, biography.

pet.fields: all crawler fields (gold/hotlist/race/class carried but unused) + owner (crawler actor id) + upgrades[] + eventsTrusted
rules: 5 stats, level, mana, Evade/DR/Move/size, skills, spells, effects, equipped gear. No inventory/gold/hotlist (only gear, skill, spell may be added).
Levels like a crawler (3 points/level) but points spendable at any floor (points.canSpend = true).
Health boxes = min(10, sizeClass(effectiveSize) + level - 1), each worth CON mod.
A pet's skills use the current floor as rank everywhere; no skill rank cap.

Upgrades are keyed by level (default 15, +5), cumulative, computed in prepareDerivedData (never written): stat bonus, size step, evade/dr/move/mana/actions bonus. Grants of skills/spells create real items (helpers/pet-upgrades.mjs syncPetGrants), matched by identifier else name, kept if level lowers. Can carry events (actor triggers only) and unlock effects.
Pet events use actor triggers only (eventTriggersActor).
GM setting a pet's owner gives the owner's player-owners OWNER permission on the pet (GM client, once).
Pet is on its crawler's side in combat.

mount.fields: owner, dr, move, attacks[<=2 of {name, roll, damage}], trample{enabled, damage}, specialNotes, occupants[string], accessories[string]
mount.derived: health.max = min(10, sizeClass(size)); Move does not cost an action (uses one mount action)

lootPile.fields: source (mob UUID|''), gold, junk, items[{uuid, quantity}]
lootPile.rules: Made by Loot on a defeated mob, or by dropping an item on the canvas. Crawlers in the combat open it (CarlRPGLootPileSheet) and claim one item at a time; gold/junk take-all or share evenly (remainder to first). Gold from a pile is tithed. Empty pile removed by GM.

fields.shortDescription: html, used on chat cards and tooltips; blank -> full description. Embeds and previews always use full.
fields.value: int gold value. GM-only visible unless an effect grants seeValues. Store listing price defaults to it; stores pay sellPercent of it.
fields.identifier: string; matches 'same item' (duplicate checks, grants, effect matching) before falling back to name
fields.tags: [string] case-insensitive; classes also have categories which count as tags
fields.interrupt: bool; using it in the react phase marks the combatant's interruptUsed flag (bolt icon on tracker)
fields.check: {target checkTargets id init unopposed, number int (mob checks)}
fields.damage: number or dice formula e.g. '1d6+@str.mod'; blank = no damage
fields.damageType: id from the world damage type list or ''
fields.targeting: {mode none|count|self|area, count formula, range string(ft|Melee|Touch|Unlimited), filter enemies|allies|any, shape circle|cone|ray|rect, size formula, lasting bool, lasts int rounds (0 until GM removes), areas formula, limit formula (0 = all), kind ''|fire|difficult|poison}
fields.requirements: [{type mana|stat|gold|actions|classTag, stat, value, tag}] must hold or the item cannot be used (warns)
fields.costs: [{resource mana|junk|uses, amount formula, max formula|''}] ranged when max set
fields.uses: {max (0 = unlimited), spent, recharge usesRecharge id, every (N for rounds), waited}

base.amounts: targeting.count/size/areas/limit and costs.amount/max are 'amounts': number or arithmetic over roll data, no dice. Operators + - * / % ** (), functions floor ceil round abs min max, tokens @path (object path uses .total). Roll data: actor stats (@str.mod ...), @lvl, @rank, @floor, @cost, @cost.mana, @cost.junk, @cost.uses, @cost.total. Implemented in helpers/amounts.mjs (never rolls).

sheetTabs._note: item-sheet.mjs _configureRenderOptions: every sheet has header, tabs, description (a Limited viewer gets only those). Then the parts below. Every type EXCEPT background also gets 'events' (events + requirements). Attribute parts are templates/item/attribute-parts/<type>.hbs.

skill.fields: rank int>=0, advanceable bool (Can Advance), passive bool (uses no action, still rolls), stat (abilities), formula (derived), upgrades[]
skill.derived: formula = '1d20 + @<stat>.mod + <rank>' plus effective.rollBonus; effective = computeEffective(system). On a pet, rank = current floor.

spell.extra: Mana cost is just a costs row; derived manaCost = least Mana cost. Hotlist-only rule can block casting.

gear.fields: slot (gearSlots), equipped bool, dr int>=0, quantity int>=1, skills [skill UUIDs it grants], rollSkill (one of skills; '' = first) , action{type none|stat|skill|custom, stat, modifier, formula}, formula derived
rules: Armor stat = sum of dr of all equipped gear. Equip/unequip via toggleEquipped(); full slot prompts a swap.
Skills it lists are added to the crawler when the gear is ADDED (equipped or not), kept on unequip, removed on removal unless raised or shared (see skillGrants).

A weapon rolls with skill rollSkill (owner can switch per copy from a menu on the gear row). Roll uses that skill's stat and rank; damage = weapon damage + skill damage/unlocked upgrades; the skill's own events also run. Missing skill: equipping adds it at rank 0 and whispers GM; rolling is blocked if the skill is gone.
action.type: none = posts description only (still fires used events), stat = 1d20 + @stat.mod + modifier, skill = 1d20 built from the skill when used, custom = formula.
Gear fires equipped/unequipped events; effects with equipLinked follow equipped state.

item.fields: quantity int>=0, skills[], rollSkill, action{...}, formula
item.note: Plain inventory item; same action semantics as gear. Consumable if quantity or uses used.

mobAbility.fields: rank, stat, formula=1d20+@stat.mod+rank (display only; mobs do not roll), plus base check.number and damage
mobAbility.note: In the Mobs Declare phase using it declares it instead (Shift uses now). Numbers hidden from players.

lootBox.fields: tier, quantity, draws (random picks), goldOverride (formula; blank = tier default), rewards[{uuid, quantity, weight}] (never other loot boxes), guaranteed[{uuid, quantity number|dice}] (outside draws)
lootBox.events: opened trigger fires only after a successful opening

achievement.rules: One per crawler (matched by identifier else name). Each grant pays its box again once removed and re-added; duplicate blocked while held. Posts card + sound cue. Granted by GM drop, Dungeon Info Award, quest reward, or Award achievement event action.

race|class|subclass.fields: grantedSkills[{uuid, rank}], prerequisites[{type, stat, value, category, uuid, tag}], earthBased (race tick; not earth = alien), hidden bool, categories[] (class and race), subclass.classUuid
rules: Chosen from floor 3 for players, race then class (GM can assign any; unmet prerequisites noted in chat). One race, one class (replace prompt). Choices permanent for players.
Granted skills added at set ranks; effects on the item copied to the actor like any item's.
Prerequisites all must hold: stat >= value, skillRank, level, race (specific), raceCategory (earthBased|alien), achievement, classTag (class categories count as tags).
hidden: not listed until prerequisites met or GM reveals it to that crawler (Dungeon Info Reveal; actor flag revealed[uuid]).

Race and Class combo: a race whose effect has modifier classCombo > 0 also acts as the class: fills Class box, counts for class tag prereqs, subclasses attach to it, players cannot take a Class item (GM can after prompt and the class then takes over the Class box).

Subclass: chooser available from world setting subclassFloor (default 6), lists only subclasses of the crawler's own class they qualify for; a crawler may hold several, Class box shows the newest. GM drop adds without replace prompt.
Race/class build benefits live as effect modifiers on the item's effects (see build-mods).

species.rules: Optional creation wizard step (world setting speciesInCreation) for animal crawlers. Sets size and Race box to its name, adds skills and effects. A later race choice overwrites the Race box.

background.fields: categories[] (creation groups childhood|adolescence|hobby|career, one or more), skills[] UUIDs (three typical)
background.rules: Creation only; never on an actor (_preCreate refuses). Player picks a background then 2 of its skills, or 'any skill' (tagged pool) if creation setting allowAnySkill.

sponsor.rules: Held by crawlers up to world setting sponsorLimit (default 3, -1 unlimited). GM-only Send gift button picks a loot box, gives it, posts a card from the sponsor. No favor level.

personalSpace.rules: One per crawler; dropping another replaces it.

club.rules: Template with description/effects/events; any number per crawler; shows read-only member list.

deity.fields: offering text, tithe 0..100 (default 5), tier 0..3 (GM sets on crawler's copy; 0 = none)
deity.rules: One per crawler (new replaces old), dropped on sheet. Tier 1..3 sections of effects stack (effect flag tier). Make offering button posts the offering text to chat. Tithe: percent of loot-box and mob gold, rounded down, taken (nobody paid); prompt to pay or skip. Header Deity box only while held.

store.fields: sellPercent 0..100 default 50, listings[{uuid, price|null=item value, quantity|null=unlimited, startStock|null, snapshot|null}]
rules: GM Open store (for one crawler or the party) shows a Buy/Sell window until closed. Buying pays gold, gives item, stacks into matching item. Selling pays sellPercent of item value and adds the item to the store (same name/type/price listing +1, else new listing with snapshot, startStock 0). Restock sets stock to startStock. Store never shows base item value; it shows its own prices.
Buy/sell are carried out by the GM client (stock changes).

quest.fields: giver, deadline{type none|floor|days, value}, objectives[{text, done}], rewardGold, rewardBox UUID, rewardAchievement UUID, completed
quest.rules: GM gives a copy to a crawler (Quests tab, owner+GM only). Owner ticks objectives. GM Complete pays gold, loot box, achievement (skips already-held achievement, quest still completes). Deadline is a label only.

effects.doc: CarlRPGActiveEffect. All effects are normal ActiveEffects; behaviour is in flags.carl-rpg. Effects on ITEMS are templates (transfer false): copied onto the actor with the item (sourceItems = ids of giving items); removed with their item unless permanent. Effects can also be created directly on actors.

flags.kind: buff|debuff|passive. Max 3 active buffs (activating a 4th prompts a swap). Debuffs unlimited. Passive never counted.
flags.stackable: debuff only; reapplying adds a stack; numeric changes multiply by stacks
flags.equipLinked: on only while the gear that gave it is equipped
flags.rounds / roundsLeft: duration in rounds, counted down when Cleanup starts; effect then switched off with chat note; count starts when switched on
flags.tier: deity tier section this effect belongs to
flags.dead / dying: markers for the Dead (permanent) and Dying effects

effects.modifiers: Effect 'changes' are always system.bonuses.<key> (picked from a menu, never typed). Keys: stat bonuses, dr, evade, move, surprise, mana (max), hotlist (count), actions, step (crawler Step), seeValues (grant: see item values), sortValue (grant: sort by value), classCombo (grant, race acts as class), advStr..advCha (>0: advantage on that stat's checks and its skills), skillStr..skillCha (+N on every skill roll using that stat; rank untouched).

buildBenefits.checkDie: value is a die like 1d4 added to the actor's own checks against target (evade or a stat): defending roll and stat check
buildBenefits.healthStat: target stat whose modifier a health box is worth instead of CON (last wins)
buildBenefits.statCap: highest enhanced value for target stat (lowest wins)
buildBenefits.skillCap: raise rank cap 15 -> 20; target scope all|skill (value = identifier)|tag (value = tag); highest matching row wins

effects.locks: An effect named in a skill/spell/pet upgrade's unlocksEffects is suppressed until that rank/level (lockedUntilRank).
effects.statusEffects: Dying (rounds left), Dead (permanent, skull overlay), Minor Injury (-2 all stats), Major Injury (-5)

events.file: helpers/events.mjs (runtime), helpers/event-editor.mjs (shared sheet editor actions), helpers/event-summary.mjs (one-line summaries), helpers/event-library.mjs, helpers/event-approval.mjs, helpers/upgrades.mjs allEvents()
holders: items: system.events + system.requirements (every item type except background)
effects: flags.carl-rpg.events, run only while the effect is on
skill/spell upgrades and pet upgrades: upgrade.events, run only once the rank/level is reached (allEvents(item) merges them)
pets: own events use actor triggers only
floor rules: world setting floorRules, run by the GM client only; no owner, so a target-less action hits every crawler

shape.event: {id, name, enabled, trigger, phase ('any'|combat phase id; only for phaseStart/phaseEnd), match 'all'|'any', conditions[], actions[]}
shape.condition: {type, negate (NOT), stat, value, phase, degree, uuid, tag, text}
shape.action: {type, mode, uuid, amount (string number|dice), targetActor (actor dropped on the action), runOn user|gm, selfItem, skipIfHas (default true), hidden, joinCombat, ignoreDR, ask (confirm first, skip if declined), text, targetGroup}

triggers.used: after an item's roll and check resolved; ctx: roll, degrees
triggers.hit: once per target that was hit (degree critHit|amazing|success); ctx target, degree
triggers.added / removed: item added to / removed from an actor
triggers.opened: loot box only; after a successful opening, never on cancel/discard
triggers.advanced: skill/spell only; rank rose through advancement
triggers.roundEnd: when Cleanup phase starts; actor trigger
triggers.takesDamage: applyDamage got through (boxes>0, mobs net>0); actor trigger
triggers.combatStart / combatEnd / floorChange /: actor triggers. combatEnd also ends effects with lastsUntil combat and restores uses that recharge round|rounds|combat. floorChange fires for EVERY world actor (fireForWorld) and restores floor-recharge uses. phaseStart/phaseEnd/roundEnd/combatStart/combatEnd fire for combatants only (fireForCombat). roundEnd also ticks effect durations, round-recharge uses and cooldowns.
triggers.actorTriggerExecutor: runActorEvents scans every item, effect and (pet) upgrade of the actor; runs on the owning player's client, or the GM's client when no player owner is connected (isPhaseExecutor)
triggers.floorRuleTriggers: floorChange (updateSetting floor), roundEnd (when Cleanup starts), combatStart, combatEnd (deleteCombat), restTaken. No phase triggers in code; the plan also mentioned round start (not built).

conditions.phase: combat started and current phase == phase ('any' passes)
conditions.degree: attack degree == degree (hit event: that target's; used event: any target)
conditions.lootItem / lootGold: opening included item (identifier else name) / gold >= value
conditions.effect: actor has the effect (by identifier else name) switched on
conditions.floorExact: floor == value (used by floor rules for one floor)
conditions.restKind: text: short|long|full, 'at least' (long counts as short)

actions.useItem: uuid of an item the owner has; item.roll() at depth+1 (no action cost, no target prompt)
actions.macro: uuid Macro; runOn user|gm; execute({actor,item,trigger}); gm runs on GM client (needs trusted events)
actions.toggleEffect: uuid ActiveEffect template; mode toggle|on|off|removeStack|removeAll; adds the effect to the target first if missing; refused if an upgrade still locks it
actions.applyEffect: same handler but for 'the target that was hit': NEVER automatic; adds an Apply button for that target on the attack card, GM clicks (queueEffect/applyQueuedEffect)
actions.addItem: uuid Item; amount; stacks quantity into existing; skipIfHas
actions.addToken: uuid Actor; amount; hidden; joinCombat. Tokens fill nearest free cells around the user's first targeted token else the owner's token; never on another token; join combat only if one exists on that scene (never starts one). Direct placement needs create-token permission + owning actor/combat, else GM client (needs trusted events). Compendium actor imported once.
actions.awardAchievement: uuid achievement; once (held = skip); reward box pays on grant
actions.revive: dead crawler back with 1 health box, no Dying, not put back in combat
actions.grantSkill: uuid skill; amount = ranks; absent -> added at that rank, present -> raised; permanent (flag raised); stops at skill cap; whisper to owner+GM
actions.removeItem: selfItem or uuid; amount reduces quantity else deletes
actions.mana: mode spend|restore; amount; not on mobs; spend warns if short
actions.health: mode damage (through applyDamage: DR, CON, damage types; ignoreDR) | heal
actions.message: text with {name} {item}; posted as event card
actions.runEvent: mode field holds another event id of the same item; runs its actions without trigger/conditions; depth+1

targetGroups.'': owner of the item/effect (or the actor dropped on the action)

events.limits: CONFIG.CARL_RPG.maxEventDepth = 5 (warns TooDeep). Action failures are caught per action and warned.

ui.itemSheetEventsTab: event cards with conditions/actions menus, drop targets for uuids, Run now (GM), Duplicate, one-line summary, Save to library, Add from library (menu or drag)
ui.library: world setting eventLibraryJournal: journal whose pages each hold one event in flag libraryEvent; anyone who can edit an item saves (players via GM relay), only GM deletes
starterTemplates: Teach a skill, then remove this item (skill left blank)
boss phase: say a line + turn on an effect at a health point, once
boss phase: swap which abilities the boss uses at that health point
ui.approval: Dungeon Info lists unapproved events with Approve / Approve all; saving as GM approves

events.performance: runActorEvents does one allEvents call per owner, prefilters by trigger, one player lookup per fire

order: 1 Mob ability in Mobs Declare phase (depth 0, not declared, no Shift): declareInsteadOfUsing -> stored as a declaration, returns
2 Dying actor cannot act (warn)
3 hotlistOnlySpells setting: spell must be on hotlist (depth 0, GM exempt)
4 checkRequirements(item): warns every unmet requirement
5 uses: needs spans.uses.min uses left

6 roll pop-up (click only; Shift skips; not for events/macros/mobs): extra bonus (number|dice), stat change, advantage/disadvantage, amount to pay for ranged costs (capped at what user has; Shift pays least)
7 build benefits (advantage, per-stat skill bonus) applied to every roll
8 chooseTargets(item, costData) for non-mob depth 0 (mode count/area; self = no prompt)
9 claim an action in combat (passive skills and depth>0 free; none left -> confirm 'use anyway')
10 weapon whose skill is gone cannot roll (whispers GM)
11 pay Mana/Junk (short -> confirm; 'anyway' spends all remaining, never below 0)
12 spend the action; Interrupt in react phase sets combatant flag interruptUsed
13 spend uses
14 _rollCore: card with item header (image, name, badges), short description (full expander), reached upgrades; roll posted; AI Favor reroll offered (not on nat 20/1, not to non-crawlers)
15 resolveCheck: degree vs each target (or Floor DC), damage roll, attack card with buttons
16 events: rolling skill's 'used', item 'used', per hit 'hit', per miss 'miss'; summaries collected into attack message flags.carl-rpg.attack.fired (GM-only line)

checks.degrees: natural 20 critHit (always hits, damage dice doubled before modifiers); margin>=10 amazing (+Floor damage); margin 0..9 success; -1..-2 nearMiss; -3..-9 fail; <=-10 majorFail; natural 1 critFail (always fails). Hit degrees: critHit, amazing, success.
checks.mobFloor: a mob target/owner pinned floor replaces global Floor in its numbers
checks.advantage: two d20 keep highest; disadvantage keep lowest

applyDamage(amount, {ignoreDR, damageTyp: damage type: effects with damageMods halve (resist), zero (immune) or double (vulnerable)
crawler/pet: net = max(amount - dr.total, 0); boxes = floor(net / health.perBox) (leftover below a box is lost); health.value -= boxes (min 0); posts a damage card
mob: net = max(amount - drTotal, 0); health.value -= net
health reaching 0 (GM client): crawler/Crawler-mob -> startDying; other mob -> defeatMob; >0 -> cancelDying
damage.attackCardButtons: carl-apply-damage with multiplier x2 / x1 / x0.5 (GM), carl-undo-damage per target (restores exact boxes lost, clears Dying it caused, once), carl-apply-effect per target+effect (GM), carl-mob-roll (crawler rolls defense or skips)
damage.noTargets: unopposed check still shows result; damage applies to whatever the GM has targeted when clicked

mobAttacks.vsCrawler: card row pending; crawler owner clicks Roll (pop-up; AI Favor reroll offered) = d20 + defenseModifier (Evade total | stat mod | Size Class) vs number; or skips (counts as standard Success for the attack). A player's result is relayed to the GM client (mobCheckRelay).
mobAttacks.injuryOnEvadeOnly: attack degree amazing -> Minor Injury; critHit -> Major Injury; recorded on combatant flag injuries, applied via applyInjury when the combat is deleted (end of combat); same severity does not stack, it lengthens (minor short->long, major long->full)
mobAttacks.vsMob: no rolls: mob number vs the same DC a crawler would face, usual degrees, no nat 20/1

combat.model: No initiative. Round = 5 phases: declare (mobs), react (crawlers), resolve (mobs), action (crawlers), cleanup (everyone). Within a phase the acting side goes together, any order. Tracker 'Next Turn' button is relabelled Next Phase; Previous Turn steps back (does not rerun events/declarations).
combat.phaseStorage: combat flag carl-rpg.phase (index). Phase change options: carlPrevPhase, carlDirection (forward|back).
combat.chat: every phase change posts a card (once, from the active GM); entering cleanup refills actions, ticks round-based effect durations/cooldowns, runs round-end events and fires Hooks 'carlrpg.cleanupPhase'
combat.actions: Generic pool. crawler/pet 2, mob typically 2, elite/boss one per crawler combatant. Using any skill/spell/gear/item/mob ability = 1 action; passive skills free; events/depth>0 free. Pips on tracker (click spends/restores for owners). resetActions at combat start and cleanup. GM Refill Actions button in tracker header (refillActions macro util) keeps bought extra actions and refills Dying crawlers too.
combat.interrupts: item.system.interrupt true + used in react phase: costs a normal action, sets interruptUsed (bolt on tracker); cleared at cleanup.
combat.buyAction: crawler spends 1 AI Favor for +1 action this round, once per round per crawler, crawler side only, not Dying; plus button on tracker pips and sheet; whispered to GM; cleared at cleanup.
combat.declarations: In declare phase GM uses mob ability -> stored (targets chosen via chooseTargets, kept on combat flag declarations {combatantId:[{id, kind ability|move, itemUuid, itemName, note, targets[], resolved}]}). Cap = combatant.maxActions. GM can declare a movement with a note. Announced to chat when react starts (never numbers); resolved in order by the GM client when resolve starts (ability -> item.roll(null,{declared:true}); move -> spends an action and posts); cleared when cleanup starts. Declarations only target tokens on the mob's own scene.
combat.defeat: mob at 0 health: defeatMob removes from all combats; Crawler-type follows Dying. End-of-combat GM whisper lists defeated, unlooted, loot-bearing mobs from THAT combat; tracker shows the same list with Loot buttons.
combat.sideOf: mob side = actor type mob; everything else (crawler, pet, mount) crawler side

dying.start: health 0 -> Dying effect lasting max(1, CON mod) rounds; GM whisper with rounds left (public Dying card/message also shown)
dying.count: -1 at each round end and -1 for every hit that gets through (boxes>0); healing (any, rests included) cancels
dying.while: no actions (rolls blocked, treated as not rolling on defense); others' healing items still work through events
dying.death: count hits 0 -> permanent Dead effect, Foundry skull overlay, removed from combat; no public announcement, GM whisper only (sound cue dying)
dying.revive: GM Revive button in header of dead crawler, or Revive event action

rests.who: crawler's own small buttons on sheet (short/long/full), /rest chat command, hotbar macro, Dungeon Info party rests (GM)
rests.gate: players only in a Safe room unless setting restsOutsideSafeRoom; GM always
rests.effect: heal/mana per constants.rests.recovery; ends effects whose lastsUntil is that rest or shorter (long ends short+long, full ends all); restores item uses (recharge short/long/full chain); runs restTaken events; cancels Dying via healing

rules.leveling: GM Level Up button (or players if setting playersCanLevel) raises level by 1 -> 3 stat points per level above 1, banked until floor>=3, then Spend Points dialog: +1 per stat, no cap. Fires Hooks 'carlrpg.levelUp'(actor, newLevel) and levelUp events.
rules.advancement: skill/spell marked Can Advance: one d20 that must beat current rank; success +1. Rank <=4 any time; rank >=5 shows end-of-floor reminder and allows ONE try per floor (item flag advanceFloor = floor of last try). Capped at skillCap (15, or 20 via skillCap build row). AI Favor is not offered on advancement. Advancement rolls are not logged in recap.
rules.uses: system.uses.max>0 limits uses; costs row 'uses' spends; recharge: round (each round end), rounds (every N rounds, cooldown counted by tickCooldowns, or combat end), combat, floor (floorChange), short|long|full rest (longer rests also restore shorter)

upgrades.rule: every upgrade with rank <= current rank applies, in rank order then listed order; worked out at use/prepare time from current rank, never written (lower the rank and they vanish)
upgrades.shape: {id, rank, description, changes[{type, value, stat}], grants[uuids, pets], unlocksEffects[identifier|name], events[]}
upgrades.changes: damageAdd (dice/number), damageReplace, dieStep (+/- along dieLadder), manaCost/junkCost/usesCost (move both ends of a ranged cost, floor 0, adds a cost where none), rollBonus, rollTarget (checkTargets id), armorPiercing, damageType
upgrades.ui: sheet description lists all upgrades (locked dimmed), chat card lists only unlocked, Attributes tab shows effective values at current rank. Default new ranks 5,10,15,20 (rank editable, any number).

targeting.when: every use at depth 0 for non-mob items, after the pop-up (so counts can read @cost), before anything is spent
targeting.modes: none = plain use; count = pick up to N tokens (prompt window stays open while clicking tokens, 'Selected N of M', remove buttons, Select nearest, range warning, range ring around user's token); self = no prompt; area = place a Foundry measured template (circle|cone|ray|rect) with live 'N tokens inside'; if player cannot create templates the GM confirms
targeting.filter: enemies|allies|any (at least one target required unless self/area)
targeting.mobAbilities: GM gets same prompt when declaring; targets stored with the declaration
targeting.lastingAreas: lasts N rounds (0 = until GM removes), template tinted by kind (fire|difficult|poison), card posted on placement and each round end with Apply buttons per token and effect; nothing applied automatically, no movement penalty
targeting.result: picks become the user's Foundry targets, so attacks read game.user.targets

rules.tags: helpers/tags.mjs: sameTag/itemHasTag/classHasTag, case-insensitive; used by prerequisites (classTag), item requirements, event conditions, skillCap scope, wizard skill pool. Tag manager/suggestions read world AND compendium items.
rules.damageTypes: helpers/damage-types.mjs: world setting damageTypes (comma list). Items carry damageType + armorPiercing (upgrades can set). Effects carry damageMods.
rules.hotlistOnlySpells: optional world rule: crawlers may only directly cast spells on their hotlist (GM and event/macro casts exempt; skills and items unaffected)
rules.aiFavor: crawler resource. Spend 1 to reroll a d20 before the result shows (item rolls, stat checks, defending rolls; not nat 20/1; shows the roll but not success). Or buy an action. GM award: Dungeon Info Award AI Favor, /aifavor, event action.
rules.skillGrants: Skills an item added record flags.carl-rpg.grantedBy [item ids] and raised. On item removal a granted skill is removed only if no other item still grants it and its rank is not above what it was given (raised flag). Whisper notice to owner+GM. Grant a skill action and advancement set raised (permanent).

creation.start: GM-only 'Create Crawler' button in the Actors directory makes a crawler and opens the wizard. A new crawler made with empty data gets flag creationPending, which shows a Create Character link on its sheet. Crawlers that are imported or duplicated are left alone.
creation.setup: System settings > Creation setup menu (creationSetup) edits world setting creationDefaults: {statMethod standardArray|roll, allowAnySkill, skillTag (default 'Starter'), freeSkills[{uuid, rank default 3}] (GM supplies e.g. Unarmed Combat; nothing built in), weapons[uuid], gear[uuid], gearPicks (default 2), laterFloors[{floor, level, gold}]}
creation.steps: basics, (species only if world setting speciesInCreation), stats, skills, weapon, gear, bio, review. Next is never blocked. Only the final Create crawler button is disabled until everything is valid; review step lists what is missing, each linking back to its step.
creation.stats: standardArray: assign [2,3,4,5,6] to the 5 stats with a row of value buttons per stat. roll: 1d6 per stat in list order, re-roll 1s, only after a button click, ~2s between stats; results saved on the crawler (flag creationStats) so closing does not allow a re-roll; GM can reset.
creation.skills: 8 skills in 4 groups of 2: childhood 1, adolescence 1, hobby 2, career 3 (rank = group). Per group pick a background then two of its skills, or 'any skill' (the skillTag pool, if allowAnySkill). No duplicate skill. Chips and options labelled 'Skill (Stat)'.
creation.weapon: pick one starter weapon; grants its rollSkill (default first) at rank 3. freeSkills also granted at their ranks.
creation.gear: pick up to gearPicks from the starter gear list
creation.bio: pastTrauma, popularity, looseEnds, regrets (+ name, gender, size on basics)
creation.notAtCreation: race, class, deity (race/class from floor 3). Exception: later-floor starts.
creation.laterFloors: a crawler created while the world floor equals a configured row starts at that level and gold and offers race+class at the end (offerOrigins)
creation.species: optional step; species item sets size + Race box + skills + effects
creation.write: applyCreation(actor, state) writes everything; planSkills(state) resolves duplicates/ranks

origins.flow: Choose Race, then Choose Class buttons (same floor-3 rule for the GM's button; GM can still assign by dropping the item). Dialog lists every option with prerequisite status; hidden ones omitted until met/revealed. Subclass chooser from subclassFloor.
origins.helpers: raceOf, classOf, comboOf, classRoleOf (class or combo), subclassesOf, latestSubclassOf, evaluatePrerequisites(item, actor), chooseOrigin, chooseSubclass, revealedOf

lootBoxes.open: openLootBox(box): draws `draws` items from rewards by weight (eligibleRewards), rolls gold (goldOverride else tier default), adds guaranteed items (quantity number|dice), tithes gold (deity), grants via grantLoot, uses the box up (quantity), posts a tier-styled card + loot sound cue, fires opened events.
lootBoxes.gates: Safe room only for players (world setting lootOutsideSafeRoom lifts it); GM always may. A crawler's unopened boxes cannot be dropped on another sheet.
lootBoxes.approval: world setting lootApproval: player does not roll; request goes to the GM client (whispered flag lootRequest, reply lootResponse) which rolls, shows, and GM approves / re-rolls / discards. No GM online: cannot open. GM leaves mid-request: nothing granted, box kept. Dungeon Info shows approvals section only while the setting is on.
lootBoxes.openAll: openAllBoxes(actor): lowest tier first (bronze..celestial, then receipt order). First click rolls every box at once and saves results on the crawler; button then reads 'Open next box (N)' and reveals one card per click. With approval the whole batch goes to the GM (Approve all, Re-roll/Discard each). Per-box Open button only when world setting lootPerBoxOpen is on.
lootBoxes.bossReward: mob.system.rewardBox: GM Give reward button on a defeated boss, pick crawlers (all default)

mobLoot.rolls: rollMobLoot: junk (number|dice), gold (number|dice, blank = none), each item rolls its own percent chance. Stacks like store purchases. Gold is tithed.
mobLoot.delivery: The Loot button (mob sheet and tracker) calls pickCrawlerAndLoot, which only calls makeMobPile: a native loot pile actor + token is made and the mob tokens link to it. Crawlers in the combat open the pile and claim items one click at a time; gold/junk is shared evenly or taken (remainder to the first). giveMobLoot (direct to one crawler) is exported but not called from module code.
mobLoot.drop: dropping an item on the canvas makes a pile (GM directly; an owner asks the GM client). An item from a crawler leaves one at a time; items with no compendium source are copied into the world.
mobLoot.needsLoot: a mob counts as looted once Loot was used; mobs with no loot set are left out of reminders

stores.note: see items.store. Window styled as a gold ledger; GM client performs stock-changing transactions (performPurchase, performSale, restockListing). Hooks: tooltips show listing Short Description.

quests.note: see items.quest. Quests tab owner+GM only; completeQuest pays reward; Quest embeds/tooltips show Short Description.

systems.sponsors: GM-only sendGift: pick a loot box, give a copy, post a card from the sponsor. sponsorLimit setting.

deity.note: see items.deity. titheOf(actor, gold) = floor(gold * percent/100) (19 gold -> 0, 20 -> 1); only loot-box and mob/pile gold; pay-or-skip prompt (pay default) and a tithe line on the loot card. Unpaid tithe has no automatic penalty; GM lowers the tier.

dungeonInfo.file: sheets/gm-tab.mjs + templates/sidebar/gm-tab.hbs. Sidebar tab id carlGM ('Dungeon Info', icon fa-dungeon), right-click the icon to pop out. Visible to players.
dungeonInfo.players: floor, party name (read-only), days left, floor state badge, floor notes for the current floor, Party Management (only the party leader's player: rename party, set titles), party panel (other crawlers' health bars only)
gm: floor +/- and number (setting floor; changing re-prepares ALL actors incl. unlinked token actors and fires floorChange events + floor rules)
floor state Exploring|Safe room (badge for players; never posts anything by itself)
days left counter -1/+1/number (manual; nothing happens at zero)
Floor rules button -> editor window (same event editor; rules run on GM client)
encounter table per floor (roll table of mobs), Roll encounter, Encounter builder
loot approval list (only while lootApproval on)
events waiting for approval + Approve / Approve all
Awards: pick achievement + Award; Award AI Favor
System announcement: kind, crawler (for died), text, banner toggle, Send
Announce Boss Battle (bosses auto-found: active combat else viewed scene; each boss after the first toggles 'vs' (new line) / 'and' (same line))

theShow.safeRoom: players' Rest and loot-box opening refused outside a Safe room unless restsOutsideSafeRoom / lootOutsideSafeRoom. GM actions always work.
theShow.systemAnnouncements: helpers/system-announcements.mjs announceSystem({kind, text, actor, banner}); kinds died|boss|stairs|floor|general; card class carl-system-card; banner = full-screen flash on every client (default on for boss, stairs, floor). Journal page type carlSystemMessage (kind, headline, text) with a Send to chat button posts the same card. /announce and @Announce also.
theShow.party: world settings partyName, partyLeader (actor id), partyTitles {actorId: title}; title shows before the crawler's name in chat (getTitle). Leader changes go GM-client via socket {type:'party'}.
theShow.encounters: helpers/encounters.mjs: tableForFloor(floor) (null floor = every floor), parseRowText('[1d3] Goblin' -> count formula), drawEncounter, placeEncounter(entries) (GM clicks a map spot, mobs placed in a tight cluster, join combat on that scene; with autoStartCombat setting on, starts one), rollEncounter. Mobs scale automatically through the Floor.
theShow.groupChecks: helpers/group-check.mjs. /group <stat|skill=Name> dc=<n|floor|unopposed> [all|most|atLeast=N] (GM), @GroupCheck[...] journal button (GM), Dungeon Info dialog. Card carl-group-card; each crawler's owner clicks Roll; once all have rolled the GM client posts the overall pass/fail by rule.
theShow.recap: helpers/recap.mjs. Journal 'Recap Log' (id in world setting recapLogId; point it at another journal there), one page per floor ('Floor N') with Nat 20s / Nat 1s sections (entry: who, item and for a weapon its skill, result, target, damage, floor, round, time) and counts in a flag. Counts: boss stars, crawler kills, Elites defeated, achievements, loot boxes opened, nat 20/1. Active GM client writes; chat catch-up when no GM was online (messages flagged recapped; advancement not logged). Floor Recap button posts a public card: row per crawler + party total + Elites defeated. Basic mobs not counted. recordRecap(entry) hook point.

journals.file: helpers/journal.mjs (+ scss). World setting journalStyle (default on) styles every journal; with it off a .carl-rpg wrapper still styles part of a page.

enrichers.@Floor, @Party, @DaysLeft: live values, update in open pages
enrichers.@Check[stat dc=12] / @Check[skill=Climbi: anyone clicks, rolls for their crawler (own/assigned), shows degree. DC number|floor (10+Floor)|unopposed (10+2xFloor)|blank usual rule
enrichers.@Gold[50] @Junk[3] @LootBox[uuid] @Effec: GM only buttons with a crawler picker; players see plain text
enrichers.@Announce[kind|text]: GM button posts a System announcement
enrichers.@Embed[uuid]: overrides Foundry @Embed for Items, ActiveEffects and mob Actors (other embeds stay Foundry's): item card in accent colour by kind (skill blue, spell purple, gear tan, item green, effect grey, mob red, other gold) with image, enriched full description, type, key numbers as chips, every upgrade's description (locked or not). Never shows events, requirements, loot odds or GM-only fields. Click opens read-only preview (or real sheet if allowed). Mob embeds show stats incl Evade/DR to anyone who can see the page. GM client supplies data to players without access.

journals.works in: journal pages, item/skill/spell/effect descriptions, chat, quest and store text
journals.callouts: CSS classes on div: carl-system (green terminal), carl-quest, carl-boss, carl-hint, carl-readaloud (parchment, journal pages only). Secret blocks styled as classified files in every context.

compendiumSources.what: System settings > Compendium sources menu stores world setting compendiumSources: for each purpose (achievements, races, species, classes(+subclasses), backgrounds, skills, mobs) whether the world's items and which compendiums feed that list. sourceItems(purpose) / sourceActors(purpose).
compendiumSources.playersWithoutAccess: installFromUuid() wraps fromUuid: a player's client that cannot read a compendium item asks the GM client over the socket and builds a read-only in-memory item with the real compendium UUID. Needs a GM connected; items-only.

systems.validate: System settings > Validate World Items (last menu): findProblems() lists broken links (background skills, loot box rewards/guaranteed, event actions' uuids, actor effects whose source item is gone). Changes nothing.
systems.crawlerSummary: Actors directory right-click > Crawler Summary: themed window with plain text (name, race, class, level, floor, stats; skills/spells with ranks; gear/inventory, gold, junk; bio, notes, personal tab) + Copy and Save as .txt. Gold/junk/notes only in the owner's copy.
systems.macros: see api. Ready-made macros JSON in packs-source/carl-rpg-macros.json (import into a compendium by hand).
systems.itemValues: item.system.value hidden from crawlers unless an effect has seeValues; sortValue lets them sort lists by value without seeing numbers; GM only edits; stores always show their own prices.
systems.skillGrantsOnItems: gear/items/deity list skills[]: added when the item is added to a crawler (equipped or not), tracked in flags grantedBy; whisper when removed with the item

stylePrinciples: Sheets fit the default size (680x760) or scroll.
Drop boxes at the END of lists, visible only when editable (actor sheets: only in edit mode). Dropping onto the sheet always works.
Quantity lives in the item sheet header for every type that has one (gear, item, lootBox).
Item hover info uses the shared tooltip: any element with data-item-tip="<item uuid>".
In-UI hint/tooltip text must be short; obvious settings get none.
Label-plus-input panels have inner padding (~4px x 6px on sheets, more in the wizard); header modifiers show no leading '+' (0 + 0 = 0; minus only when negative).
Players never see mob numbers (Evade, DR, health values) except where noted.

itemListFeatures.filterSort: helpers/item-filter.mjs: filter bar above every item list on actor sheets: search (names; toggle adds descriptions), type chips (computed: skills/spells Attack|Passive|Utility, gear slot/Equipped/Weapon|Armor/Consumable, effects Buff|Debuff|Passive + Active, mob abilities Attack|Other), tag menu with All/Any, Clear. Sort: name, type, rank, mana cost, uses, slot (equipped first), manual, Value (only with sortValue). Per-person per-list, stored in the browser. Stays usable while sheet locked.
itemListFeatures.rowDescriptions: each row has a chevron; description collapsed by default (per person per item, localStorage); expand/collapse all in list heading; shows enriched description, upgrades with unlocked marked, key numbers line. Clicking the picture or a use button rolls; clicking the name toggles.
itemListFeatures.tooltip: helpers/item-tooltip.mjs itemTooltipHtml: name, badges, then Short Description (or full). Used on sheet lists, hotlist, quick bar, shop listings, store window, quests, loot boxes, achievements, mob loot, granted skills, target prompt and roll pop-up.
itemListFeatures.badges: helpers/item-badges.mjs describeBadges/badgeRowHtml: stat, type, damage at current rank, mana cost, range, targets/area, weapon skill + stat, DR for armor, quantity/uses. Mob ability numbers hidden from players.

quickBar.what: bar above the hotbar for the controlled crawler (hidden when none; hides the hotbar while shown): every hotlist slot (min 10, empty slots too, same size), shows rank (weapon shows its rolled skill's rank), mana cost, uses. Click uses; Shift skips the pop-up. Keys 1-9 use slots 1-9 and 0 slot 10 via Foundry keybindings quickBar<n> (rebindable); slots past 10 click-only. Re-renders on controlToken, updateActor, updateItem, createItem, deleteItem, canvasReady.
quickBar.hotlist: crawler tab: one box per slot (system.hotlist.size), pick skill, spell, gear or inventory item from the dropdown; click rolls

chat.cardFlag: flags.carl-rpg.card.kind: skill|spell|gear|item|mobAbility (item type), achievement, boss, check, defense, effect, event, loot, system. chat-cards.mjs adds classes as cards render; check cards coloured by degree; mob cards keep mob colour (their 'success' is not shown green).
chat.headers: skill/spell/gear/item cards: item image + name + badges; roll options (advantage/bonus/stat), AI Favor reroll note, what the use cost are badges; description shows Short Description with 'Full description' expander
chat.changeLog: helpers/change-log.mjs: each automatic change (mana, actions, use, event) is a line in a collapsed 'Changes' section on the causing card; with no card, posted shortly after as a whisper to GM + owners. GM sees all, players their own.
chat.diceSoNice: helpers/dice-hold.mjs: client setting holdResultCards (default on) hides result cards until Dice So Nice finishes. Nothing changes without the module.
chat.sounds: helpers/sounds.mjs: world settings soundBoss, soundNatural, soundDying, soundAchievement, soundLoot (audio file each, empty = silent, none shipped); client soundVolume (0-100) and soundMuted per player; plays on every client seeing the cue (flag cue, natural 20/1 by a crawler, achievement given).

tokens.nameplate: crawler number as second line (Crawler # N), Crawler Killer skulls (up to 5 icons then one skull + count) and boss stars beside the name; same on chat cards; sheet portrait is round with skulls upper-left and stars opposite corner. Kill counts hidden in the header while locked, editable by GM/owner in edit mode.
tokens.bars: mob token bars on for everyone (fill only; no numbers); pet tokens linked + friendly
tokens.overlays: Dead and defeated mobs get Foundry's skull overlay

ui.interfaceStyle: client setting uiStyle (default on) re-skins Foundry's own UI; chatLogStyle (client, default on) game-style chat; journalStyle (world, default on). Accent colour royal purple via --dcc-accent / --dcc-accent-bright in the palette; danger reds via --dcc-danger(-bright).
ui.defenseRollPopup: roll pop-up (helpers/roll-dialog.mjs promptRoll/buildFormula/optionsNote): extra bonus, stat change, advantage/disadvantage, cost amounts. Used by item rolls, sheet ability rolls and a crawler's defending roll. Shift-click skips.
ui.rollDataAccess: abilities sidebar: click a stat rolls d20 + mod vs 10 + Floor; (observer permission may roll)

settings._note: Namespace carl-rpg. visible = config:true (shows in Configure Settings). Menus are buttons in system settings.

world.use: global Floor; onChange re-prepares all actors
placing mobs with no combat starts one

world.default: Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison, Acid, Necrotic, Psychic

world.use: blank = Recap Log journal created/used by name

globals.globalThis.carlrpg: {documents:{CarlRPGActor, CarlRPGItem}, applications:{CarlRPGActorSheet, CarlRPGItemSheet}, utils:{rollItemMacro(uuid), refillActions(combat?)}, models}
globals.game.carlRpg.macros: rest(kind 'short'|'long'|'full') -> confirmRest; levelUp(); advance() (asks which advanceable skill). All act on the selected token's crawler, else the user's character, else the first owned crawler.
globals.caution: two namespaces with different casing (carlrpg vs carlRpg); see quirks

hooks: carlrpg.cleanupPhase (combat) fires once on the GM client when Cleanup starts

chatCommands./rest <Crawler|self|all> short|long|full: owner or GM; all = GM only; keeps safe-room rules
chatCommands./aifavor <Crawler> <amount>: GM; minus takes away; floor 0; posts card
chatCommands.note: Read in the chatMessage hook; nothing posts as the command itself.

api.hotbar: Dropping an owned Item on the hotbar creates a script macro (flag carl-rpg.itemMacro) -> see quirks (broken call). Dragging a sheet's Rest / Level Up button makes macros calling game.carlRpg.macros.

keyFunctions.actor.addGold / spendGold: only gold entry points (loot, shops, events)
keyFunctions.item.roll(event, {depth, declared}): the one use path; events/macros call it with depth+1

actor.defeatedIn: combat id a mob was defeated in

item.grantedBy: [item ids] on skills an item added
item.raised: bool; skill rank raised by crawler/grant, protects from removal
item.advanceFloor: floor of last advancement try (skills/spells rank>=5)
item.storeSource: key on items bought from a store
item.itemMacro: on hotbar macros made from items

combatant.injuries: {minor: n, major: n} applied when combat deleted

chatMessage.attack: check record {itemName, itemUuid, type, targetKey, number|dc, degree, damage, floor, targets[{tokenUuid, actorUuid, name, state pending|resolved, degree, hit, damage, rolled, skipped, injury, applied}], fired[]}
chatMessage.relays: updateRelay, eventRelay, libraryRelay, lootRequest, lootResponse, mobCheckRelay, pileRelay, storeBuy, storeOpen, storeSell (whispered, handled and deleted by the active GM client)

journalPage.recap: counts for a floor's recap page

permissions.Limited: opens a locked sheet showing only Notes (biography); name/portrait
permissions.Observer: can roll from the sheet; automatic changes (mana, actions, uses, AI Favor) done through the GM client relay; cannot unlock/edit; items on actors are read-only for Observers; sees mob Evade/DR
permissions.Owner: edit mode, everything incl. gold, hotlist, notes, quests

visibility.hiddenFromNonOwners: gold/junk, hotlist, notes (biography text sections), quests tab
visibility.mobNumbersHiddenFromPlayers: Evade, DR, health values, floor override, ability numbers (cards, sheets, tooltips, tokens show only the bar). Shown to GM and Observers on the sheet. Journal @Embed of a mob deliberately shows stats.

tests.run: npm test (node tests/run.mjs: one node --test process per *.test.mjs, 163 pass)
tests.stubs: tests/stubs.mjs fakes Foundry globals (settings, Actor/Item shapes, i18n, Roll) so helpers import under plain Node

files.events.test.mjs: triggers, conditions, actions, trust, add-token, approval
files.progression.test.mjs: level up, advancement, origins, upgrades, skill cap

tests.notCovered: templates, sheets, ApplicationV2 rendering, hooks wiring, socket/relay flows, canvas. Those are verified only by static checks until a Foundry run.

forAgentsEditing.tools: desktop-commander MCP (start_process, edit_block, write_file; load with ToolSearch if needed). Do not use Set-Content/Get-Content to edit files.
forAgentsEditing.lineEndings: Files may be CRLF in git (core.autocrlf true). edit_block fails on multi-line CRLF matches: for multi-line edits write a throwaway .cjs script with exact-once string replacements (normalize CRLF to LF, replace, convert back), run it, then delete it. Use a function replacer and check afterwards for a literal $1.
forAgentsEditing.neverEdit: build/ (generated). css/ is untracked output of npm run build.

quirks.detail: Macros created by dropping an owned item on the hotbar run game.carlrpg.rollItemMacro(uuid). Nothing sets game.carlrpg (the global is globalThis.carlrpg with rollItemMacro under .utils; game.carlRpg only has .macros). Those macros will throw. Fix: point the command at globalThis.carlrpg.utils.rollItemMacro or expose it on game.carlRpg.
